events.title: US midterm elections: Democratic sweep of Congress
events.why_it_matters: Democrats won both chambers, ending unified Republican control and immediately triggering a $2 trillion tech/AI infrastructure rotation on expectations of tighter regulatory oversight, while also raising the probability of budget brinkmanship.
events.what_to_watch: Whether the lame-duck Congress can pass a stopgap funding bill before December 11 and how aggressively the incoming Democratic majority signals antitrust and AI regulation priorities.

events.title: US October CPI
events.why_it_matters: The October CPI print is the last major inflation read before the December 8–9 FOMC; a hot core print would cement the near-fully-priced December hike and pressure rate-sensitive sectors.
events.what_to_watch: Any revision to core services ex-shelter and the market-implied odds for a December 25bp hike, which were already above 90% ahead of the release.

events.title: China extends suspension of 24% retaliatory tariff on US goods for two months
events.why_it_matters: Beijing kept the 10% tariff but suspended the additional 24% until January 10, 2027, averting near-term escalation and reducing tail risk for exporters and supply chains.
events.what_to_watch: Whether the truce holds through the APEC summit later this month and whether Washington reciprocates with any tariff relief.

events.title: Russia-Ukraine-US trilateral ceasefire talks in Abu Dhabi
events.why_it_matters: First face-to-face talks in nine months; any progress on a Black Sea ceasefire or energy-infrastructure truce would weigh on energy prices and lift European risk assets, while failure keeps the war premium intact.
events.what_to_watch: Whether the parties agree to a follow-up round and whether Russia signals any concession on occupied territories.

events.title: Iran denies US nuclear talks resumption after reports of near-deal
events.why_it_matters: Reports that Washington and Tehran were close to a preliminary deal on uranium enrichment and frozen funds briefly lowered oil risk premia, but Iran's security chief flatly denied the talks, reviving uncertainty around the Strait of Hormuz.
events.what_to_watch: Any confirmation or denial from the White House and whether Qatari/Pakistani mediators schedule a formal round.

events.title: Three oil tankers explode in Strait of Hormuz
events.why_it_matters: The IRGC reported three tankers struck mines, briefly spiking Brent toward $109 and raising supply-disruption risk for global energy markets.
events.what_to_watch: Insurance rates for Hormuz transits and whether the IRGC escalates or de-escalates its maritime posture.

events.title: Trump says renewed Iran strikes 'unlikely and unnecessary'
events.why_it_matters: De-escalation rhetoric after the Hormuz tanker incidents reduces the immediate tail risk of a wider military conflict that could disrupt oil flows.
events.what_to_watch: Whether the rhetoric is matched by a reduction in US naval deployments or by continued IRGC provocations.

events.title: LA-Long Beach port watchmen strike deferred to November 20
events.why_it_matters: A stopgap deal delayed a strike by ~250 terminal watchmen at the busiest US port complex, but the new November 20 deadline keeps freight uncertainty alive amid a rail backlog measured in weeks.
events.what_to_watch: Whether ILWU Local 26 and the PMA reach a contract before November 20 or whether a work stoppage disrupts 85% of Long Beach container traffic.

events.title: COP31 climate summit in Antalya
events.why_it_matters: Negotiations on climate finance, adaptation and the 1.5°C target can shape long-term policy expectations for fossil fuels, utilities and carbon-intensive materials.
events.what_to_watch: Whether a climate-finance work programme is agreed and whether major emitters signal stronger 2035 NDCs.

events.title: SEMICON Europa 2026 in Munich
events.why_it_matters: The flagship European semiconductor conference spotlights advanced packaging, fab management and Europe's AI-era chip strategy, with read-through for capex expectations across the semi supply chain.
events.what_to_watch: Any commentary from TSMC, ASML, Infineon or Siemens on AI demand durability and European fab investment.

events.title: TSMC October sales rise 59.7% year-on-year
events.why_it_matters: TSMC's October revenue growth challenges fears of an AI spending slowdown and supports the semiconductor complex ahead of Nvidia's November 17 print.
events.what_to_watch: Whether TSMC's advanced-packaging capacity commentary confirms sustained AI accelerator demand into 2027.

events.title: Anthropic IPO roadshow
events.why_it_matters: Anthropic is marketing 825 million shares at $70–78 (up to ~$1.4T valuation), and pricing will set the tone for the entire AI complex and the 2027 tech IPO pipeline.
events.what_to_watch: Final pricing on November 18 and first-day trading on November 19 under ticker ANT; a weak debut would pressure AI infrastructure names.

events.title: South Korea early-November exports surge 111.9% on chip demand
events.why_it_matters: Semiconductors accounted for nearly half of the $33.5 billion in November 1–10 shipments, a real-time signal that AI-driven chip demand remains robust despite broader tech volatility.
events.what_to_watch: Whether the chip-led export strength persists through the full month and feeds into Bank of Korea's November 26 rate decision.

events.title: EU Court of Justice landmark ruling on AI copyright and input legality
events.why_it_matters: The CJEU's first ruling clarifying whether AI training inputs are legal versus AI outputs infringing copyright sets a precedent for model developers and content owners across the US and Europe.
events.what_to_watch: Whether the ruling forces changes to training-data practices at major AI labs and triggers follow-on litigation.

events.title: Congress returns for lame-duck session with Dec 11 shutdown deadline
events.why_it_matters: Republicans must pass a funding bill before December 11 to avoid a shutdown, but Democrats—set to take Congress in January—have leverage to extract concessions on healthcare and the Iran conflict.
events.what_to_watch: Whether a clean stopgap or a broader omnibus emerges, and whether the farm bill and defense authorization slip into 2027.

events.title: Cisco Q1 FY2027 earnings
events.why_it_matters: Cisco is a key read on AI networking and enterprise infrastructure demand; its guidance can either stabilise or deepen the recent tech drawdown.
events.what_to_watch: AI infrastructure order growth and whether management raises FY27 revenue guidance above $18.2B.

events.title: US October PPI
events.why_it_matters: Consensus is +0.4% m/m and ~6.6% y/y, keeping pipeline inflation uncomfortably high and reinforcing the Fed's hawkish stance ahead of the December meeting.
events.what_to_watch: Core PPI and any services components that feed into the Fed's preferred inflation measures.

events.title: Baidu Q3 2026 earnings
events.why_it_matters: Baidu is a key China internet/AI read; advertising weakness or AI-cloud strength will shape sentiment on China tech ahead of Tencent and Alibaba.
events.what_to_watch: AI cloud revenue growth and any commentary on regulatory pressure on search advertising.

events.title: Nvidia Q3 FY2027 earnings
events.why_it_matters: The single most important AI bellwether; guidance will determine whether the recent AI trade drawdown stabilises or deepens across semiconductors and mega-cap tech.
events.what_to_watch: Data-center revenue growth, Blackwell/Rubin shipment commentary, and gross-margin guidance for FY2027.

events.title: Home Depot Q3 2026 earnings
events.why_it_matters: Home Depot is a key read on housing turnover and big-ticket discretionary spend, with the US housing market frozen near 30-year lows.
events.what_to_watch: Comparable sales and any commentary on pro-customer demand versus DIY weakness.

events.title: Disney Q4 FY2026 earnings
events.why_it_matters: Disney's streaming profitability and parks demand are a bellwether for media and consumer discretionary spending into the holiday season.
events.what_to_watch: Direct-to-consumer operating income and any guidance on content spend and parks capex.

events.title: US October retail sales
events.why_it_matters: A key read on consumer resilience after strong payrolls; a weak print would contrast with hawkish Fed pricing and complicate the December decision.
events.what_to_watch: Control-group sales and whether the September strength (+0.8% m/m) was sustained.

events.title: Target Q3 2026 earnings
events.why_it_matters: Target's discretionary mix makes it a sharper read on consumer stress than Walmart; weak results would reinforce the slowdown narrative.
events.what_to_watch: Apparel and home-category demand, inventory levels, and any holiday-season guidance.

events.title: Tencent Q3 2026 earnings
events.why_it_matters: Tencent is the bellwether for China platform regulation and gaming/AI investment; guidance can move the entire China tech complex.
events.what_to_watch: Gaming revenue recovery, fintech/cloud growth, and any commentary on AI capex.

events.title: FOMC October meeting minutes
events.why_it_matters: Minutes will reveal how close the committee was to a December hike and whether any members pushed back, shaping rate expectations into the December 8–9 meeting.
events.what_to_watch: Language on the persistence of services inflation and the degree of consensus around a December move.

events.title: Anthropic IPO pricing and Nasdaq debut
events.why_it_matters: Pricing on November 18 and first-day trading on November 19 will be the largest AI IPO to date and a sentiment gauge for the entire AI complex.
events.what_to_watch: Whether ANT prices at the top of the $70–78 range and whether the stock holds above issue in the first session.

events.title: Walmart Q3 FY2027 earnings
events.why_it_matters: Walmart is the best real-time read on the US consumer; slowing comparable sales or cautious guidance would signal holiday-season risk.
events.what_to_watch: US comparable sales, e-commerce growth, and grocery inflation commentary.

events.title: Alibaba Q2 FY2027 earnings
events.why_it_matters: Alibaba's e-commerce and cloud results will show whether China's consumer recovery is holding and whether AI-cloud demand is accelerating.
events.what_to_watch: Customer management revenue growth and cloud segment profitability.

events.title: Japan October national CPI
events.why_it_matters: Core CPI is expected near 2.1%; a hotter print would reinforce BoJ hawkishness and yen strength, with spillovers into global rates and carry trades.
events.what_to_watch: Services inflation and whether the BoJ signals a December hike.

events.title: Palo Alto Networks Q1 FY2027 earnings
events.why_it_matters: Cybersecurity demand is a resilient sub-segment of tech; strong results could partially offset AI-infrastructure weakness.
events.what_to_watch: Remaining performance obligations and billings growth.

top_risks: A hot October core CPI or PPI print cements a December Fed hike and extends the rotation out of rate-sensitive tech and real estate.
Nvidia's November 17 guide disappoints, deepening the AI-infrastructure drawdown that began after the Democratic midterm sweep.
Anthropic's IPO prices below range or breaks issue on November 19, damaging sentiment for the entire AI complex and the 2027 IPO pipeline.
Russia-Ukraine talks collapse and Iran denies nuclear diplomacy, reviving the Middle East war premium and pushing Brent back above $110.
The December 11 US funding deadline becomes entangled with Democratic leverage, raising shutdown risk into year-end.
top_opportunities: China's two-month tariff suspension and South Korea's chip-led export surge reduce near-term trade tail risk and support Asian tech.
A de-escalation in Iran/Hormuz and progress in Ukraine talks would lower energy prices and lift European and EM risk assets.
Walmart and Target results confirm the US consumer is holding up, supporting consumer defensive and select discretionary names into the holidays.
Cisco and Palo Alto Networks show AI networking and cybersecurity demand is durable, offering a relative safe haven within tech.
TSMC's 59.7% October sales growth and robust AI orders validate the semiconductor upcycle ahead of Nvidia.
summary: Markets are digesting a historic Democratic midterm sweep and a hot inflation pipeline, with the December Fed hike nearly fully priced. The next two weeks are dominated by Nvidia and Anthropic's IPO, US retail sales and PPI, China tech earnings, and fragile geopolitical talks on Ukraine and Iran. Uncertainty is elevated because a single hot inflation print or weak AI guide could swing rate expectations and the AI trade.
